questions: Should the TF-IDF vectorizer be configured with any specific parameters (e.g., stop words, token pattern, lowercase, max_df, min_df, ngram_range) beyond the default?
Does 'outermost matching square brackets' mean we remove the longest possible match from '[' to ']' (greedy) or the shortest (non-greedy)?
How should overlapping or malformed brackets (e.g., unmatched '[' or ']') be handled?
Should the text be preprocessed (e.g., stripping whitespace, normalizing spaces) before TF-IDF calculation?
Is the TF-IDF computed on the exact string after bracket removal, or should punctuation (like parentheses in test case 4) also be removed?
Should the function handle multiple documents (e.g., split the input by some delimiter) or treat the entire remaining text as a single document?
Are numbers (like '1234' in test case 2) intended to be removed as part of bracketed content, or should they be tokenized if outside brackets?
What should be returned if the text after bracket removal is empty or only whitespace?
